purpose: Identify which upstream E/A/U/W background factors compose with the grouped MLP6--7 source to gate its behavioral use across grammatical directions on reused fronted OOD text.

binding_evidence.finding: The grouped-source head law transfers geometrically, but its exact task effect crosses from live recipient/dead donor-context in plural-to-singular to dead recipient/live donor-context in singular-to-plural.
The exact whole-MLP8 signed response transfers to this OOD syntax with native capability and lexical specificity.
On matched HOLDOUT text, MLP6 and MLP7 remain one interacting operational source and the full E/A/U/W/Y/Z factorial is exact.

novelty_audit: Canonical and repository searches for {mlp6_7, background, OOD} and {mlp6_7, composition, OOD} return zero prior events.
This does not repeat tangent geometry or split MLP6 from MLP7. It resolves the newly observed direction-by-background task-use gate by intervening on E/A/U/W composition.
map: For every reused OOD row and source in {opposite-number, same-number lexical}, evaluate all 16 recipient/donor subsets T of E/A/U/W both without and with grouped X=MLP6+MLP7. Run the exact native MLP8-to-L11H3 map and native tail. For each cell form q(T)=effect(T union X)-effect(T), perform exact Boolean-lattice Mobius inversion on E/A/U/W/X, and Shapley-allocate every interaction containing X equally among its non-X background members. The signed allocations sum exactly to q(EAUW)-q(empty).

predictions.pred_a_instrument_and_endpoint_closure: All replay/no-op/state/normalized-state gates, finite checks, Mobius closure, and rowwise reproduction of the bound tangent empty/EAUW base/exact margin and CE endpoints are at most 5e-5.
predictions.pred_b_single_background_factor_gate: The same one factor among E/A/U/W has at least 65% of absolute Shapley allocation mass in both directions and its signed allocation agrees with the total context shift.
predictions.pred_c_distributed_background_gate: Prediction b fails and at least two background factors each have at least 20% absolute Shapley allocation share in both directions.
predictions.pred_d_higher_order_background_gate: In either direction, Mobius terms containing X and at least two background factors carry at least 35% of the absolute nonempty-background interaction mass.
predictions.pred_e_direction_reversal: The exact margin shift q(EAUW)-q(empty) is at most -0.05 for plural-to-singular and at least +0.05 for singular-to-plural. This is a closure/decomposition check of the already observed endpoints, not independent evidence.
predictions.pred_f_lexical_effect_absolutely_small: Across all 16 backgrounds and both directions, absolute same-number lexical q(T) margin is at most 0.02. This is an absolute-collateral statement and does not repair the failed relative specificity claim.

null: If the instrument holds but neither b nor c holds, no stable first-order background gate is identified; preserve the exact signed interaction table. If d holds, a single-factor story is incomplete even when b also holds. Do not tune attribution thresholds or split MLP6/7 again.
closed_claims: necessity outside the fixed L11H3 interface
